## 💡 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of what feature you would like to see.

## 🎯 Target Area
- [ ] Notes Editor & Markdown
- [ ] Knowledge Graph Visualizer
- [ ] Visual Canvas & Diagrams
- [ ] Plugin API & Extensions
- [ ] Theme & UI

## 📋 Problem Statement & Use Case
What problem does this solve? How will this improve user workflows?

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution / Architecture
Describe how this could be implemented within NoteMesh's existing architecture.

## 🔗 Related Issues / Prior Art
Links to any similar features in Obsidian, Foam, Logseq, Miro, or Excalidraw.
